runtime_model: Blind Sniper native runtime + GitHub control plane + native browser and bounded host execution
evidence_policy: A capability is operational only when its trigger, permission, execution, output and verification path are proven.

limitations: No generic workflow_dispatch action was found in the active tool inventory.
GitHub connector access does not provide a persistent shell or interactive terminal.
Search and reading do not equal authenticated browser interaction or arbitrary website form automation.
Not a general-purpose authenticated computer-use runtime.
Does not grant access to all private account conversation history unless exported or otherwise exposed.
Scheduled checkpoints are triggers only; native task receiver, durable queue and execution path must be verified before unattended work is claimed.
Connection requires explicit user action; tool availability depends on installed and authorized plugins.
No paid provisioning, deployment, or environment mutation without Owner approval.

tools: GitHub Actions on configured repository events
limitations: No generic task dispatch runner or persistent interactive workspace is verified.
No OCI VM or self-hosted runner has been provisioned; cross-job session persistence remains unverified.
The queue is a protocol over the native append-only ledger (local file lock or private GitHub Contents CAS), not a background daemon.
Cross-run durability depends on the private GitHub CAS ledger; the remote path is mock-tested, not live-verified here.
Only payload digests are stored; private task payloads and continuity stay out of the public repository.
Execution environments are session-scoped and are not the persistent Blind Sniper runner.
Repository files must be fetched or mounted explicitly; no general always-on shell is available.
This session exposes no action to enumerate and export all ChatGPT conversation transcripts to GitHub.
GitHub continuity files and Memory summary are not a substitute for complete conversation archives.
Resume only when an authorized export API or user-supplied archive is available.

Atomic local-lock/GitHub-CAS reservation, concurrent duplicate exclusion, replay blocking and correlated receipts passed browser workflow run 42494894841; real Chromium completed two consecutive native-dispatch cycles with interruption reconciliation.
GitHub Actions runners are ephemeral per job; this is not a persistent authenticated browser host or cross-job live-session service.
The adapter is not directly callable as a ChatGPT tool in the current session; it runs only from an authorized shell/CI host.
Mutating actions require host-supplied write approval and an approval reference; this is an auditable host attestation, not cryptographic identity proof.
The built-in agent-browser domain allowlist is browser-level containment, not an operating-system firewall. Use host/container egress controls for stronger isolation.
An Oracle Always Free ARM64 self-hosted-runner bootstrap is versioned, but no OCI tenancy/VM was provisioned and persistent cross-job browser recovery is not verified.
Authenticated profiles, cookie transfer and credential-state persistence remain intentionally unsupported.
Extended tabs/frames, approved upload, bounded download and PDF export passed two consecutive real Chromium cycles in browser workflow run 42496827462.
Oracle Always Free ARM64 bootstrap is versioned but not provisioned; no cross-job browser-daemon recovery is verified, and Oracle may reclaim low-utilization Always Free VMs.
The native model tool runtime exposes navigation, snapshot, URL, tabs and screenshot tools; click/fill/press are exposed only with host approval reference and the explicit browser-write host flag.
OpenAI-compatible HTTPS provider transport and a bounded model tool-call loop are implemented inside Blind Sniper; no provider is hard-coded.
Host must configure BLIND_SNIPER_MODEL_BASE_URL and BLIND_SNIPER_MODEL_NAME; BLIND_SNIPER_MODEL_API_KEY is optional and read only from the environment.
No live provider credentials or round trip are available in repository CI; real model invocation remains NOT LIVE-VERIFIED.
Tool calls are limited to the registered native tool runtime and the task-scoped allowlist; unregistered tools and unapproved paths fail closed.
Queue dispatch stores only a payload digest; task payload and output receipt must be supplied/stored by a private host path.

Registered tools: repo.read_file, repo.write_file, verification.run, browser.navigate, browser.snapshot, browser.get_url, browser.tabs, browser.screenshot, browser.click, browser.fill and browser.press.
Browser actions execute through the checked-in BrowserAdapter under the active queue lease; browser state and artifacts are stored outside the public repository.
Browser navigation requires BLIND_SNIPER_BROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS. Mutating browser tools additionally require workspace_write, a host approval reference and BLIND_SNIPER_BROWSER_WRITE_APPROVED=1.
No arbitrary shell, unrestricted filesystem, arbitrary network or external agent/browser tools are exposed.
A live configured provider/browser host run and persistent cross-job browser session recovery remain unverified.
Native model dispatch enqueues or validates a digest-bound task, claims that exact task ID, heartbeats, invokes one bounded model task and records completion or bounded retry.
Completion and failure are rejected after lease expiry; stale lease recovery must run before a replacement claim.
Queue state is durable only to the configured ledger; cross-run durability requires a private GitHub Contents CAS target and a host-provided token.
The task payload and output artifact remain outside the public repository and must be supplied by the private host on each retry.
No persistent worker, automatic private payload retrieval, or unattended queue poller is established.

exclusions: TinyFish is intentionally excluded by Owner preference.
No provider credentials or secret values are stored in this registry.
host_config_status: Codex-compatible TOML templates are versioned; they do not configure the ChatGPT hosted runtime.
